title: Law 4.1/4.3 Probe: 1% Minority Mode Inside Saturating 3*tanh Rail
intuition: Places 4 major modes (99% mass) at (+-1.5, +-1.5) and a single 1% minority mode at (0.0, 2.85) inside the saturating tail of a `3.0 * tanh(...)` generator, grading strictly on generated outputs (5/5 modes, rare_mode_recall >= 0.45).
failure_mode: Global pushforward trust regions calibrated by the 99% bulk modes suppress the steep pre-activation step needed to reach the 1% rail-adjacent mode, or vanishing tanh gradients starve it completely.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe (800 updates, P=512, B=256, 4L saturating tanh generator).
